1.explanation:
• table/index.md: shows the main Table API (fixedHeader, resizable, filter) and default prop behavior.
• table/adaptor/index.jsx: contains the core rendering logic for header cells, fixed‐header positioning, and resizable handles—likely where the overlay positioning is computed.
• table/theme/index.jsx: defines CSS-in-JS styles for fixed headers, overflow containers, and dropdown panels that may clip or misplace the filter UI.
• table/demo/fixed-header.md: demonstrates how fixedHeader is implemented and helps reproduce header freezing behavior.
• table/demo/resize.md: shows how resizable columns work together with header cell width adjustments.
• table/demo/filter&sort.md: illustrates the filter dropdown usage in headers, providing context on how the filter panel should behave when opened.
1.bug_scenario: In a Table component with both fixedHeader and resizable columns enabled, clicking the column‐header filter button causes the header’s filter dropdown panel to display in the wrong place, get clipped behind the scroll container, and misalign with its column. The fixed header styling and cell borders break, and the filter UI floats under the body rows rather than remaining attached to the fixed header.
